_doc: The Hindsight Hermes plugin the reference install runs (hermes plugins install vectorize-io/hindsight; the catalog's own code, no local edits: the installed copy was byte-identical to the catalog tree except its catalog stamp). krew-install.py --memory installs it by this repo slug; this file is the pin a clean install is checked against (version, repo, sha).
config: crew/hindsight/config.example.json -> $HERMES_HOME/hindsight/config.json (the only file the plugin reads; auto_recall off)
